stock.description: Capinfo Company Limited, established in Beijing in 1998, delivers comprehensive information technology solutions throughout the People's Republic of China. Its primary services include software development, system integration, data processing, and professional IT consulting. The company also offers innovative platforms and tools such as Shouxintong, a secure and open mobile platform built upon core technologies like sandbox, cloud computing, big data, and microservices. Further offerings encompass VR visualization, data profiling, intelligent data search, bespoke application development, and advanced multidimensional data analysis, alongside IoT sensing systems and applications utilizing fundamental blockchain services. Capinfo extends its services to crucial public infrastructure, including e-governance systems, medical insurance and social security card systems, housing provident fund systems, air quality monitoring, community service information, and credit settlement information systems.
